headline: Drones with small on-board AI models identify and attack targets autonomously
summary: Two reports describe drones running small, non-frontier AI models that identified and attacked targets without human input or external communications. One names the vendor and describes decentralized AI-driven learning deployed to military bases and drones; the other specifies Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano hardware and describes a recent demonstration. The texts differ on whether this is deployment or a demo.
